crosswalks.label: Computer and Information Research Scientists
crosswalks.rationale: Computer and Information Research Scientists ground algorithm/information-science work relevant to ranking/relevance systems but are broader research roles.

crosswalks.label: Data Scientists
crosswalks.rationale: Data Scientists ground modeling/evaluation/behavior analysis while search-objective and ranking-system ownership remains distinct.

crosswalks.label: Software Developers
crosswalks.rationale: Software Developers ground implementation of ranking/search systems but not relevance judgment or product objective authority.

findings.summary: Search/Relevance Engineering should be separated from SEO/search marketing: it optimizes retrieval/ranking systems and evaluation, not content visibility marketing.
findings.rationale: Research-first compilation makes the profession boundary explicit before use.

gaps_against_body.description: Make offline relevance metrics, online/human value, source truth and product/policy objectives separate evidence and authority surfaces.

nonclaims: No complete Search / Relevance Engineer reconstruction is claimed.
Occupational mappings are evidence, not profession identity.
No TEST/WORKING/CANON or adjacent authority is created.

high_stakes.authorization_nonclaim: No adjacent professional, user, legal, platform or institutional authority is created.
